metadata.title: Run Local Tests
metadata.purposeAndUsage: Execute existing unit and integration tests to verify no regressions were introduced by the implementation. Fix any failures before proceeding.

output.description: Test results — all passing or failures identified and fixed

specificActions: Identify test commands from project configuration
Run unit tests and integration tests
Fix any regressions introduced by implementation
bestPractices: Run tests before making any fixes to establish baseline
Only fix regressions caused by the implementation
Re-run full suite after each fix

substeps.name: Identify test commands
substeps.description: Find correct test commands from project config
actions: Check for test framework config (jest.config, .mocharc, etc.)

substeps.name: Run integration tests
substeps.description: Execute integration test suite if available

substeps.name: Fix regressions
substeps.description: Fix test failures caused by implementation
actions: Fix regressions in implementation or test code

substeps.name: End-Step: Compliance Check
actions: Output: '✓ Step completed in compliance with operating principles'

flow.description: Identify commands → run unit tests → run integration tests → fix regressions (conditional) → store results
